fanTake: Sunday at EverBank Stadium was an absolute catastrophe—the kind of performance that makes you question everything. Drake Maye delivered the sixth-worst quarterback game of the entire NFL season, and a defense that couldn't stop Jacksonville if they were playing in slow motion watched the Jaguars convert every single red-zone trip into a touchdown while we limped to 6 points on two field goals. The 29-point loss is the worst we've suffered since Week 17 of 2024, and Jacksonville's +0.23 EPA per play allowed ranks among the twelve most dominant defensive outings all season—except it was *their* offense doing the dominating against us. We lost the turnover battle by two, converted just 33% of our third downs while Jacksonville hit 67% of theirs, and the whole thing was rotten from start to finish. Marcus Jones was the only bright spot, keeping us in it as much as anyone could, but when you're losing 35-6 on the road, even the silver linings feel like fool's gold.
